cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The lift's broken. We can cancel the gym and use the stairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. A full programme included in the rent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we carry the shopping?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Resistance training. We've saved two memberships.

mechanism: A treats the broken lift and shopping burden as opportunities for a more efficient combined fitness routine, correcting B exercise method as a self-appointed trainer.
confusable: D20 merely stays optimistic; D44 must invent a faster, cheaper or smarter routine from each inconvenience.
comparison: Meal alternative combines food service and cleanup; stairs alternative combines home access, shopping and exercise costs.
seedUse: Broken lift, eight floors and shopping weights derive from D44-a; S03 adds structured workout corrections to the saving claim.
